### Dataset:
The Amazon Products co-purchase network contains 54,025 products. Each product (node) is represented as a bag-of-words feature vector of 2,000 words from the product title and description. Edges represent co-purchase relationships — two products are connected if customers frequently buy them together.

narrative: The GNN model predicted the category of the target product, "Hayabusa Chikara Fight Shorts," as "Sports & Outdoors" with a confidence of 58.29%. Conversely, several high-importance words such as "tech," "help," and "mesh" are absent, indicating that while they could influence the decision, their absence focuses the model on other available indicators. The direct co-purchase neighbors, particularly products like "Muay Thai MMA Ankle Support Wraps" and "Hayabusa Pro Training Series Kick Shield," which are also in the "Sports & Outdoors" category, strongly influence the prediction, suggesting a pattern of associated sports equipment purchases. Furthermore, the presence of 2-hop neighbors such as "Titan Competition Headgear" and "Brazilian Jiu Jitsu Uniform" further supports the sports theme by connecting through common purchases of similar gear, indicating a shared usage context. These associations underscore the sporting nature of the target product and align with customer behavior patterns, solidifying its classification in the sports domain.
